public_site.title: Red Harbor IWW
public_site.location: Aberdeen, Hoquiam, and the surrounding Grays Harbor region
public_site.about: Red Harbor is a branch of the Industrial Workers of the World organizing workers across Grays Harbor.
public_site.hero_headline: Building worker power on the harbor and beyond.
public_site.hero_text: Red Harbor is a branch of the Industrial Workers of the World. We organize across workplaces, support workers in struggle, publish branch updates, and build solidarity rooted in direct action and rank and file power.
public_site.about_intro: Red Harbor is the local IWW branch for Aberdeen, Hoquiam, and the surrounding region. We build organization, education, and solidarity among workers and support workers who want to organize where they work.
site_purpose_items: Connect workers with the Red Harbor branch and the IWW.
Share branch news, events, organizing resources, and labor history.
Give members a clear path into the private organization workspace.
Build durable worker organization rooted in direct action and solidarity.
public_site.about_card_body: The IWW organizes workers across industries and trades around the principle that workers should build power together rather than rely on bosses, politicians, or professional intermediaries.
public_site.location_card_body: Serving workers in Aberdeen, Hoquiam, and communities throughout the harbor.
public_site.join_intro: Whether you want to join the IWW, organize your workplace, support another worker in struggle, or take part in branch activity, there is a place to begin.

join_cards.title: Join the branch
join_cards.body: Become an IWW member and take part in Red Harbor meetings, education, campaigns, and mutual support.

join_cards.title: Organize your workplace
join_cards.body: Talk with us about workplace problems, organizing with coworkers, and building collective power where you work.

join_cards.title: Join the broader struggle
join_cards.body: Support workers in struggle, take part in labor solidarity, and help build working-class organization across the harbor.

public_site.membership_title: Join the IWW through Red Harbor
public_site.membership_intro: The Industrial Workers of the World is a member-run union open to workers across industries. Red Harbor is our local branch on Grays Harbor.
public_site.membership_details_body: Most workers can join the IWW, including workers who are unemployed or underemployed, students, retirees, self-employed and informal workers. Workers who belong to another union can generally join as well, except officers of other unions and people whose primary role is hiring or firing workers.
membership_includes_items: Workers already represented by another union, except union officers
membership_dues_items: Initiation fee: one month of dues
public_site.membership_cta_title: Ready to get your red card?
public_site.membership_cta_body: Join the IWW through the union's membership system, then connect with Red Harbor as your local branch.
